'''John Anders Bárány''' (born 13 July 1942, dead 14 October 2025) was a Swedish scientist working in the field of [[theoretical physics]].

==Career==
Bárány became a doctor of philosophy in theoretical physics at [[Uppsala University]] in 1973 and later became university doctor at the same university.<ref>Anders, Bárány. Non-adiabatic transitions, 1973</ref> During the 1980s he worked at the Research Institute for Atomic Physics in Stockholm.<ref name=ff>{{cite web|url=http://fof.se/person/anders-barany|title=Anders Bárány|work=Forskning & Framsteg – Populärvetenskapligt magasin|accessdate=1 November 2014}}</ref><ref name="Sommar i P1 30/6: Anders Bárány">{{cite web|url=http://www.gp.se/kulturnoje/1.2416025-sommar-i-p1-30-6-anders-barany|title=Sommar i P1 30/6: Anders Bárány|accessdate=1 November 2014}}</ref> Since parts of the institute was transferred to [[Stockholm University]] and renamed as the Manne Sieghbahn Laboratory, Bárány became a professor there.<ref name="Sommar i P1 30/6: Anders Bárány"/><ref>[http://www.nobelmuseet.se/zino.aspx?articleID=10976 Nobelmuseet.se]{{Dead link|date=January 2016}}</ref>

Bárány has worked at the Kungliga Vetenskapsakademien.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.svd.se/nyheter/inrikes/akademien-skallde-ut-pratsam-ledamot_8604476.svd |title=Akademien skällde ut pratsam ledamot |author=Stockholm TT |work=Svenska Dagbladet |accessdate=1 November 2014 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140717163531/http://www.svd.se/nyheter/inrikes/akademien-skallde-ut-pratsam-ledamot_8604476.svd |archivedate=17 July 2014 }}</ref> He was an editor at Physica Scripta between 1988 and 1996 and secretary for the [[Nobel committee]] in physics between 1989 and 2003.<ref name=ff/><ref>[http://www.ne.se/uppslagsverk/encyklopedi/l%C3%A5ng/physica-scripta ne.se]</ref> Bárány has been the chairman of the Kungliga Vetenskaps Societeten in [[Uppsala]] since 1994, and of the Kungliga Vetenskapsakademien since 2005.<ref name=ff/> He was earlier the chairman of the [[Nobel Museum]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.svt.se/nyheter/vetenskap/nobelkommitten-maste-andra-beslutet|title=Nobelkommittén måste ändra beslutet|work=svt.se|date=3 October 2011 |accessdate=1 November 2014|last1=Brohult |first1=Linus }}</ref>

Bárány was given the honour of being the host of the radio show [[Sommar i P1]] at [[Sveriges Radio]] [[SR P1|P1]] on 30 June 2014.<ref>[http://sverigesradio.se/Diverse/AppData/Isidor/Files/2071/14326.pdf Sverigesradio.se]</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sverigesradio.se/sida/avsnitt/391830?programid=2071|title=Anders Bárány|date=30 June 2014 |accessdate=1 November 2014}}</ref>

Bárány was yelled at by the [[presidium]] at the Vetenskapsakademien for revealing in Sveriges Radio as to why the announcement of the winner of the [[Nobel Prize in Physics]] 2013 was delayed.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nyteknik.se/nyheter/innovation/forskning_utveckling/article3777418.ece|title=Fysikpriset: Akademien skällde ut pratsam ledamot|work=NyTeknik |publisher=Nyteknik.se|accessdate=10 November 2014}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Bárány is the son of Ernst Bárány and psychiatrist Margit Boman-Bárány, and the grandson of Nobel prize recipient [[Róbert Bárány]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bikupan.se/bikupan/cv/cv2.html|title=CV|accessdate=1 November 2014}}</ref> He is the father of Sigrid Bárány, who was winner of the cooking show ''[[Sveriges mästerkock]]'', broadcast on [[TV4 (Sweden)|TV4]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tv4.se/efter-tio/klipp/s%C3%A5dan-far-s%C3%A5dan-dotter-sigrid-och-anders-barany-2468108|title=Sådan far sådan dotter: Sigrid och Anders Bárány – Malou Efter tio |work=tv4.se|accessdate=1 November 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141101220455/http://www.tv4.se/efter-tio/klipp/s%C3%A5dan-far-s%C3%A5dan-dotter-sigrid-och-anders-barany-2468108|archive-date=1 November 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref>
